_note: Standing exposure, 0 (none) to 3 (high). natural = hurricanes, wildfire, storms, drought. supply_chain = dependence on one country or supplier. First estimates to review once a year.

XOM.why: Gulf Coast refining and chemical plants sit in hurricane paths.

CVX.why: Gulf Coast and Gulf of Mexico operations.

COP.why: Mostly onshore; Alaska and winter storm exposure.

EOG.why: Onshore Texas; winter storms can shut in wells.

OXY.why: Gulf of Mexico platforms and Gulf Coast chemicals.

EQT.why: Appalachian gas; pipeline freeze-offs in cold snaps.

LNG.why: Export terminals on the Louisiana and Texas coasts.

VG.why: Export terminals on the Louisiana coast.

KMI.why: Large Texas and Gulf Coast pipeline footprint.

WMB.why: Transco pipeline runs through hurricane states.

ET.why: Texas and Gulf Coast pipelines and terminals.

EPD.why: Houston Ship Channel terminals and fractionation.

NEE.why: Florida Power and Light faces direct hurricane landfalls.

SO.why: Georgia, Alabama and Mississippi storm exposure.

AEP.why: Spread across 11 states; ice storm exposure.

SRE.why: California wildfire risk and Texas storms through Oncor.

ETR.why: Louisiana and Texas Gulf Coast hurricane exposure.

XEL.why: Wildfire liability in Colorado and the Texas Panhandle.

NGG.why: UK and US Northeast winter storms.

VST.why: Texas grid winter storm risk, as in Winter Storm Uri.

NRG.why: Texas retail and generation exposure to extreme weather.

CCJ.why: Kazakhstan joint venture adds country risk.

LEU.why: Depends on imported enriched uranium, including from Russia under waivers.

BWXT.why: US government contracts and domestic plants.

UEC.why: US and Canadian projects; small producer.

NXE.why: Remote Saskatchewan site; still in development.

GEV.why: Global factories; some components sourced abroad.

VRT.why: Meaningful component sourcing and manufacturing in China.

PWR.why: Storm repair work can add revenue; crews face weather delays.

FSLR.why: US, India and Malaysia factories; no Chinese polysilicon.

ENPH.why: Relies on contract manufacturers in Asia.

RUN.why: California exposure; imported panels and batteries.

FLNC.why: Battery cells sourced largely from China.

OKLO.why: Needs specialty reactor fuel with limited US supply.

SMR.why: Specialty nuclear components with few suppliers.

XE.why: Specialty fuel supply is still being built.
